title: Divisibility cancels out of a sum on the right
statement: For a positive natural d and naturals a, b: if d divides a and d divides a + b, then d divides b.

formal.statement: theorem Nat.dvd_add_right_cancel_of_pos : ((x0 : AxNat) -> ((x1 : AxNat) -> ((x2 : AxNat) -> ((x3 : AxNat.le (AxNat.succ AxNat.zero) x0) -> ((x4 : AxNat.dvd x0 x1) -> ((x5 : AxNat.dvd x0 (AxNat.add x1 x2)) -> AxNat.dvd x0 x2))))))

evidence.supports: Nat.dvd_add_right_cancel_of_pos is admitted by the trusted kernel gate with the type recorded in formal.statement.
